name: ax-narrate
title_zh: 把一次会话的隐情写成可回放的故事档案
tagline_zh: PR 只记录最终代码，但用户改了什么、试错几次、工具挂在哪，全被丢进黑洞。装上它，每次会话的暗线都变成可审阅的 J。
tagline_en: PRs show what shipped; this captures what didn't—your corrections, dead ends, tool failures. Turn every session's.
desc_en: Write the agent-generated narration of the current session - the reviewable story of what changed, including what never reaches a PR (user corrections, abandoned attempts, tool failures). Triggers on "narrate this session", "summarize what changed", "write the session story", "narrate what we did", "session narration". Output is .ax/narrations/<session-id>.json for the ax studio narration view. Do
why_zh: 它不总结代码差异，而是记录决策轨迹：用户纠正、放弃的尝试、工具报错。这些从不进 PR 的暗线。
why_en: It doesn't diff code—it traces decisions: your corrections, abandoned attempts, tool errors. The subplot PRs never show becomes.
limit_zh: 只认 ax studio 生态，输出固定为 .ax/narrations/<session-id>.json。
limit_en: Tied to ax studio only; writes .ax/narrations/<session-id>.json. No other workflow, no prose summary—outside ax's viewer, the file is inert.
